question: Write a detailed response explaining the significance of Let us read in the chapter, using the source evidence and supporting details.
answer: I “Who put that water bag here?” roared my father from the front doorstep. “Your burglar alarm,” I hissed to my brother Anand, who was getting ready to disappear from the house. Ma rushed in to see what the racket was all about and found Papa standing there, sopping wet and scowling.
